run_ml_model_evaluation: run cross-validation ML model evaluation for HER or CO2R experimental product prediction using linear or random forest regressors
run_load_and_preprocess_data: run load_and_preprocess_data to merge experimental, computational, and XRD CSV files into a unified dataframe for OCx24 analysis
run_add_el_features: run add_el_features to compute and append Matminer elemental descriptors like atomic mass and radius to the experimental dataframe
run_cross_val_predict: run cross_val_predict with leave-one-composition-out or leave-one-out CV splits to generate predictions for each target product
run_plotly_scatter: run plotly scatter plot generation with OLS trendline to visualize experimental versus ML predicted values with R2 and MAE annotations
